services.name: Fishing Trips
services.desc: California has some of the best fishing in the world. With Southern California and the greater Los Angeles area getting a mix of local and in transit fish species. There is an abundance of selection with species variations depending on the time of year. With everything from lobster to sea bass, a private fishing charter is an amazing experience enjoyed on the day of and with a seafood feast after. Book today and go sportfishing in Marina del Rey, Redondo or San Pedro. Fishing is an art form.
